title: Very Good
body:
I’m in a period where I have to study and focus very hard. When my friend showed me this app, I was so happy. It helps focus without interruptions and motivates you to learn. 
I recommend this app very hard. 👏👏👏👏
author: Melisa Odok

title: Bien mais…
body: Elle aide beaucoup à la concentration cependant je trouve cela dommage qu’on ne puisse pas écouter de la musique (utilisation d’applications musicales) en même temps mais le reste est super bravo
author: Shrek Lpb

title: super app, trés recommandé
body: trés bonne app pour voir son progrès de travail /  concentration.
author: ariixbadidea

title: Super app
body: App complète, des stats, des pomodoros et même une IA etc… super cool, les petits trucs pratiques pour se concentrer réunie dans la même app. Juste peut-être, interface d’accueil pas assez épurée.
author: Jey00000000

title: Amazing!
body: It’s really cool with great graphics and i love how you can focus with others, though i can’t seem to talk to than after the session..? Oh well. Still best focus app i’ve ever tried!!
author: Protect The Rainforests!!!!

title: So cool
body: Its always very helpful when i have to focus, and its so playful and funny so im staying motivated and away from my phone 📱 thank you so much for creating this app ✨
author: Leonaaaaaaaaa_

title: Simple and Motivating
body: Focus Plant really helps you to stay focused for exams stuff which you have to learn. Its great
author: Lets be kind

title: Love it
body:
I love the plant, the cuter the better !!

I love seeing them grow, but the lose cuteness along the way:/

But wince I downloaded the app, i just want to be in focus mode to get more plants. It really helps with my phone addiction and helps me get things done. I don’t procrastinate as often anymore.
author: scfgzgzhxjcj

title: End of Session vibration
body: I really like the app, but I always miss the vibration signalling the end of a focus phase. It would be nice if you had to manually stop the vibration.
author: christøph

title: Great 👍🏼
body: This is a great game that helps you concentrate! It’s very relaxing
author: ℂ𝕒𝕟𝕕𝕪𝕔𝕣𝕦𝕤𝕙

title: To do List!
body: I really like this App. There‘s just one thing that could be better. Please could you put a to do list on the App?🙏
